notes.title: Nomyou 1.097 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Patch Notes – v1.097 - 15 June 2025

Dialogue Fixes – Resolved an issue where some dialogue lines were not being displayed as intended.

High FPS Bug – Fixed a bug that caused unexpected behaviour at extremely high frame rates (500+ FPS).

Spelling Corrections – Minor text and spelling errors have been corrected throughout the game.

Ultra-Widescreen Fix – UI elements that were previously off-screen on ultra-widescreen monitors have been properly adjusted.

Final Ascent Jump Tweak – A jump near the end of the game has been made slightly easier to complete without the double jump ability.

Controller Support Improvements – Adjustments have been made to improve compatibility and behaviour when using controllers.

Sticker has been added by a Patreon backer.

Can now toggle fullscreen and resize the window in settings.
